tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page and preview background — the sheet the document sits on.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs, inputs and the editor pane when it sits beside the preview.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Side panels: file tree, outline, history. One step quieter than paper.

tokens.name: paper-code
tokens.usage: Code block and inline code ground inside the preview.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel dividers, table rules, code block borders. Decorative only — never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that identify a control (inputs, secondary buttons, checkboxes). Holds 3:1 on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on every paper token.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, timestamps, helper text, tree items that are not active. 6:1+ on every paper token in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled labels, placeholder icons and the tree's chevrons only. 3:1+ — never for text a reader needs.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: md.IT teal. Primary action fill, active tab, focus ring, links, the dot in the wordmark. As text, on any paper token or accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for the active tree row, selected segment and accent badges; accent text on it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (the primary button). Never literal white — the dark theme's accent wants dark text.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: Search matches and ==highlighted== text; ink on it. The only warm hue — use it for finding things, nothing else.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Success and 'Saved to cloud'. Blue, not green, so it never relies on hue against danger; always paired with a check icon or a word.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind positive text in badges and callouts.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution: unsaved local work, browser-storage risk. Always with the alert icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and failures: delete, save failed, version conflict. Always with an icon or the word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind danger text.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links in the preview — an alias of accent so both move together.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every surface.

families.mono: "Geist Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Geist for every piece of chrome: toolbars, tree, panels, dialogs. Small and calm — the document is the loud thing on screen.

styles.name: ui-title
styles.usage: Dialog titles and the project name in empty states.

styles.name: ui-heading
styles.usage: Panel headings and section labels in menus.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.sample: Your work stays in this browser until you save a version.
styles.usage: Default interface text: buttons, dialog copy, callouts.

styles.name: ui-label
styles.usage: Tree rows, segmented controls, form labels.

styles.name: ui-caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, counts, save status, helper text — in ink-muted.

groups.name: Document
groups.note: What the preview and exports render. Headings in Geist, prose in Source Serif 4 — a reading face for long technical text. Users can swap the prose family through --doc-font.

styles.name: doc-h3
styles.usage: ### heading; #### and below use ui-heading at 16px.

styles.name: doc-body
styles.sample: Each process gets a fixed slice of CPU time before it is preempted.

styles.name: doc-small
styles.sample: Figure 2 — context switch cost at 10 ms quantum.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: Geist Mono for the editor, code blocks, inline code and keyboard keys.

styles.name: code-editor
styles.usage: The CodeMirror editor. Taller leading than code blocks so Markdown source reads like prose.

styles.name: code-block
styles.usage: Fenced code blocks in the preview.

styles.name: code-label
styles.usage: The language label on a code block, uppercase, ink-muted.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Interface density lives in space-1 to space-4; the document breathes at space-6 and up.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside compact controls.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons; horizontal padding of tree rows and badges.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control horizontal padding; gap between list items in panels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; callout and code block padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; space between document blocks.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above ## headings in the preview.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Preview side padding (the --doc-padding default).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Top of the preview; empty-state vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, kbd keys, inline code, tree rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, segmented controls, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Code blocks, callouts, menus, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots and the range thumb only.

shadow.note: Borders do the structural work; shadows are reserved for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, tooltips and dialogs — anything above the page.

size.note: Fixed layout dimensions for the workspace shell.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small buttons, icon buttons in toolbars, tree rows.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Height of default buttons, inputs, segmented controls.

tokens.name: toolbar-height
tokens.usage: Top bar of the workspace.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Default file tree width (resizable 200–400px).

tokens.name: doc-measure
tokens.usage: Max width of the rendered document column.

doc.note: Rendering-setting defaults (PRD 5.6), set on the preview root; the settings panel overrides them and exports read the same values. The prose family, --doc-font, defaults to var(--font-serif) in bundle.css.

tokens.name: doc-letter-spacing
tokens.usage: Prose letter spacing; settings range -0.02em to 0.06em.

tokens.name: doc-line-height
tokens.usage: Prose line height; settings range 1.3 to 2.

tokens.name: doc-margin
tokens.usage: Outer margin around the document column; settings range 0–96px.

tokens.name: doc-padding
tokens.usage: Inner padding of the document column; settings range 16–96px.
